notes.title: Important update!
notes.content:
Last week, we announced our new upcoming game: Automobilista - Motorsports Simulator. www.game-automobilista.com . The game will be free to all existing owners of Stock Car Extreme, so long as you bought or have your copy activated here on Steam, all you have to do now is wait for it to become available!

For those who do not yet own Stock Car Extreme, today January 5th 2016 is the last day to buy it for its current price and also ensure a free copy of Automobilista. By its release, Automobilista will be priced US$ 39.99.

Starting tomorrow January 6th, Stock Car Extreme will have its base price dropped from US$ 29.99 to US$ 19.99 - however from then on it will no longer warrant a free copy of Automobilista.

So if you still don´t own Stock Car Extreme and are looking for a great deal, make sure to grab it now!

Stock Car Extreme V1.33 Released!
notes.content:
First a small note to let you all know we have some big news coming up shortly which should make june a very important month for SCE - watch this space!

In the meantime we thought you might enjoy some cool new toys to play with for this last weekend of may :)


Main changelog for v1.33:

Content

Cars:
Added 250cc Superkart series (make sure to set steering rotation between 180º-220º for accurate steering ratio)

Track:
Added Kansai (2 layouts)

Features & fixes:
Improved AI paths for Interlagos (all layouts);
Fixed fuel estimates for Guaporé;
Updated curb sounds for Marcas;
Various minor physics & AI updates;
Minor optimization for Buenos Aires.

Game Stock Car Extreme v1.25 Released - Available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VabdqsHUWRo

GSC Extreme v1.25 is out - now also on Steam!

[B]Steam Release Info[/B]

If you already own it you may now switch your Serial Number for a Steam key from the official GSC Extreme website:

[URL]http://game-stockcar.com.br/steam-key/?lang=en[/URL]

This is valid for purchases made from release until yesterday (February 9th). New non-Steam purchases will NO LONGER warrant Steam keys.

Existing NonSteam installs will continue to work even if you do switch your Serial Number for a Steam key, but you will not be able to use the Serial Number again for an install in a fresh system.

Moving to Steam is recommended, but not required. Just like in this release, the plan is to continue updating both versions simultaneously. If you do prefer to keep multiple installs of the game for mods, be advised that for now is not possible with Steam.

[B]INSTALLATION (Non-Steam users):[/B]

Update to v1.25 by running GSC Sync.


[B][B][B][B][B]Main changelog for v1.25:[/B][/B][/B][/B][/B]

[B]Content[/B]

[B]Cars:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Added Metalmoro MR18 Prototype series
[*]Added GX390 rental karts to KARTS series
[/LIST]
[B]Tracks:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Added Johannesburg Historic
[*]Added Ortona (4 layouts)
[*]Updated Goiânia to post-2014 reform
[/LIST]
[B]Features & fixes:[/B]

[LIST]
[*]Extensive audio revision from new onboard & trackside recordings bring updated sounds to all cars;
[*]Tyre physics updates for all cars further improving lateral / longitudinal force combining;
[*]Adjusted terrain properties (road, curbs, grass & gravel)
[*]The hard compound for the F-Extreme & F-Reiza now has its proper orange Pirelli sidewall label;
[*]Corrected bug with corrupted textures in the F-Vee cockpit when running graphics detail lower than max;
[*]Corrected bug with Spielberg & Buenos Aires corrupted textures when running graphics detail lower than max;
[/LIST]

[B]Known issues:[/B]

Several code-related issues reported from v1.21 are still present in this build, as the code is going through a rewrite which has not been completed in time for v1.25. For that reason v1.25 has the following known issues:
[LIST]
[*]Bug in the scoring in championship mode for all series;
[*]F-Extreme can occasionally disappear when hitting 8th gear in multiplayer;
[*]F-Extreme & F-Reiza tyre restrictions are not applying in pitstops.
[/LIST]

Among other minor issues which are known and will be addressed in the coming weeks, along with the adittion of other features previously expected for v1.25.

For issues installing / running / setting up GSCE, please refer to [URL=http://game-stockcar.com.br/?page_id=196&lang=en]our FAQ[/URL] first before posting.

notes.title: Metalmoro MR18 Preview & Release Update!
notes.content:
Below we have a video preview of the LMP Metalmoro MR18 running at dusk at Taruma for your eyes! The car will be available very shortly to users of the game on both Steam and for those with current installs via GSCSync!

Existing owners who wish to convert there install to Steam will be able to get their GSC Extreme Steam key by Tuesday! There will be a page live on [url=http://www.game-stockcar.com.br]the official Game Stock Car website[/url]

Tomorrow 09/02 will be the last day to buy GSC outside Steam and still be able to retrieve a Steam key. From 10/02 onwards, while it will remain available outside Steam, new purchases will not longer warrant a Steam key.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9rRQvIIen3g

notes.title: STATUS UPDATE
notes.content:
STATUS UPDATE (it has been a while): After some headaches, we are finally set to release Formula Truck 2013 & Game Stock Car Extreme on Steam. Both titles are being updated and are currently undergoing betatesting, we hope to have it all ready before the end of the month. Here´s a little teaser to show you we might have been quiet, but still working hard!

While we are at it, best wishes to all our fans for the new year - 2015 promises to be very exciting for simracing, we will certainly make our contribution to that end :)


STATUS UPDATE (já faz um tempinho) Depois de algumas dores de cabeça, finalmente estamos prestas à lançar o Formula Truck 2013 & Game Stock Car Extreme no Steam. Ambos games serão atualizados estão passando por betatesting, esperamos ter tudo pronto até o final do mês. Aqui um pequeno teaser para mostrar que apesar do silêncio, o trabalho segue firme!

Aproveitando a oportunidade, desejamos à todos nossos fãs um excelente ano novo - 2015 promete ser um grande ano para o automobilismo virtual, e nós certamente faremos a nossa contribuição para isto
